raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 18
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer prematurely concluded that all 97 January 2020 hep-lat articles had .ps versions by incorrectly assuming the presence of “[other]” formats implied .ps availability for every paper. They did not verify per-article format options or count actual .ps links, conflating total submissions with the subset that offered .ps. The correct count is 31, so the error stems from misinterpretation and lack of verification.
